name: 基金产品信息
description_zh: 本Skill基于广发证券权威数据接口构建，支持查询基金完整详情，包含净值、收益率、风险等级、申赎规则、基金经理、基金公司与综合评价，用于基金资料查询与基本面对比。
description_en: GF Securities fund detail query tool, supporting comprehensive fund information including NAV, return rate, risk level, subscription/redemption rules, fund manager, fund company, and comprehensive evaluation. Suitable for fund research and fundamental comparison.
